Beginner.learningGoal: Transform arrays and dictionaries with map, filter, reduce and sorted.
gotchas: sort mutates in place while sorted returns a copy
reduce with the wrong initial value breaks empty input
Dictionary iteration order is not guaranteed
goodSolutionShows: map/filter/reduce chains instead of manual loops
shapeHints: summing order totals above a threshold
sorting contacts by last then first name

Intermediate.learningGoal: Use grouping, zipping, compactMap, flatMap and Dictionary(grouping:) / merging.
gotchas: flatMap on collections flattens while on optionals is different
stable sorting is guaranteed only for sorted in recent Swift versions, so tie-breaking should be explicit
shapeHints: grouping transactions by month and summing
pairing names with scores via zip

Advanced.learningGoal: Write efficient custom collection algorithms and lazy pipelines.
gotchas: Lazy collections re-evaluate closures on every access
Array slicing keeps original indices, so ArraySlice index 0 may not exist
goodSolutionShows: lazy to avoid intermediate arrays with first(where:) short-circuit
An extension on Sequence or Collection with clear generic constraints
shapeHints: a sliding window and chunked extension
a top-K selection without full sort
